# c0mpute

> Decentralized compute marketplace. CLI-first. Pay workers with spare GPUs to run your jobs. Run your own GPU and earn. MIT-licensed, open source.

## Getting Started

- [Install](https://c0mpute.com/getting-started): One-line install via `curl -fsSL https://c0mpute.com/install.sh | sh`. Supports Linux and macOS (x86_64, aarch64).

## Run a node

- [Run a node](https://c0mpute.com/providers): `curl -fsSL https://c0mpute.com/install.sh | sh` installs c0mpute and starts the worker (Linux, macOS, Windows via WSL2; CPU or GPU). The goal is 100,000 nodes, enough pooled capacity to train and serve open-weight models in the open.
- [Market](https://c0mpute.com/market): GPU nodes online with each operator's listing. `c0mpute pricing set --min <usd>` = dynamic pricing (idle bids 60% of the buyer's cap, rising to the cap as the queue fills) never under the floor; `--fixed <usd>` = one price. The listing (`pricing: {mode, min_usd, fixed_usd}`) is in https://c0mpute.com/api/nodes.
- [Node board](https://c0mpute.com/nodes): every node online now, ranked by `c0mpute bench` score. JSON at https://c0mpute.com/api/nodes.
- Referral links: https://c0mpute.com/r/<handle> gives an install line with `C0MPUTE_REF=<handle>`; nodes installed with it show the handle on the board. Public scoreboard, no payout.

## Docs

- [CLI Reference & Cookbook](https://c0mpute.com/docs): Full CLI walkthrough — identity/wallet, workers, transcode jobs, AI inference, reputation, plugins, health checks.

## Modules

- [Plugins](https://c0mpute.com/plugins): Three core modules — transcode (FFmpeg-based video encoding), coinpay (DID identity + escrow payments), infernet (AI LLM inference).

- [Blog](https://c0mpute.com/blog): Project updates and articles.
